programs.desc: It's Refugee Week on The Cook Up. Fashion designer Anjilla Seddeqi and Refugee Council Ambassador Lizzy Kuoth join Adam to share the food that is always on their tables.

programs.desc: Squeaky, salty haloumi is one of the world's best-loved grilled cheeses. However most of it is now mass produced using cows milk. Will heads to the island of Cyprus to see how it's traditionally made.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: With immunity off the table, the top six bakers pair up to build a magnificent meringue tower.

programs.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
programs.desc: Learn how to make mouth-watering Yee Sang. Victor has a few tricks for slicing the perfect julienne at home, as well as some presentation tips to make your salad a showstopper.

programs.title: Luca's Key Ingredient

programs.title: Mary Berry's Cook & Share
programs.desc: Mary Berry starts the Edinburgh marathon & surprises runners at the finish line with chocolate treats. She also visits the Botanic gardens, sharing recipes that showcase its produce.

programs.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico

programs.desc: The competition has headed to Edinburgh where first to host are front of house Matthew and chef Yaw from Bundits. They are hoping to impress their guests Buumba and Mario of Riverlife.
